title: DyssomniaNN: Multi-Scale Spiking Neural Modeling of Human Sleep Disorders and Perceived Restedness
abstract: arXiv:2610.13918v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Clinical sleep medicine repeatedly documents profound divergences between objective sleep duration and subjective daytime impairment, notably exemplified by sleep state misperception in paradoxical insomnia and boundary instability in narcolepsy type 1. Here, we present DyssomniaNN: a multi-scale biophysical computational framework coupling Borb\'ely's two-process regulation of sleep homeostasis and circadian drive with Saper's hypothalamic reciprocal flip-flop circuit and a recurrent corticothalamic leaky integrate-and-fire spiking neural network. We formalize five clinical cohorts across an identical 72-hour photoperiod: healthy control, circadian rhythm sleep-wake disorder (delayed-phase), chronic insomnia, paradoxical insomnia, and narcolepsy type 1. translated_title: DyssomniaNN：人类睡眠障碍与主观休息感的多尺度脉冲神经建模
translated_abstract: 临床睡眠医学反复记录到客观睡眠时长与主观日间功能损害之间的深刻分歧，典型例证包括矛盾性失眠（paradoxical insomnia）中的睡眠状态误感知，以及1型发作性睡病中的边界不稳定现象。在此，我们提出DyssomniaNN：一个多尺度生物物理计算框架，该框架将Borbély的睡眠稳态与昼夜节律驱动双过程调节模型，与Saper的下丘脑相互抑制“跷跷板”回路以及一个递归的皮层-丘脑漏积分放电（leaky integrate-and-fire）脉冲神经网络相耦合。我们在相同的72小时光照周期下形式化了五个临床队列：健康对照、昼夜节律睡眠-觉醒障碍（延迟时相型）、慢性失眠、矛盾性失眠和1型发作性睡病。合成局部场电位在所有典型频段上与来自PhysioNet Sleep-EDF数据库的真实人类脑电图频谱高度吻合。
tldr: 提出多尺度脉冲神经网络框架DyssomniaNN，将睡眠稳态双过程模型、下丘脑“跷跷板”回路与皮层-丘脑脉冲网络耦合，成功模拟五种临床睡眠障碍并复现真实脑电特征，为客观睡眠与主观休息感之间的分歧提供了机理解释。
en_tdlr: DyssomniaNN, a multi-scale spiking neural network framework coupling Borbély's two-process sleep regulation with Saper's hypothalamic flip-flop circuit, simulates five clinical sleep disorders over 72 hours and reproduces empirical EEG spectra, mechanistically explaining the divergence between objective sleep and subjective restedness.
